package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// SectionRepoPG implements SectionRepository.
type SectionRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r SectionRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, section domain.Section) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO section (id, source_key, tech_id, status, lesson_read_access, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1,NULLIF($2,''),$3,$4,$5,$6,$7)`,
		section.ID, section.SourceKey, section.TechID, section.Status, section.LessonReadAccess, section.CreatedAt, section.UpdatedAt)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

func (r SectionRepoPG) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.Section, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, tech_id, status, lesson_read_access, created_at, updated_at FROM section WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var section domain.Section
	if err := row.Scan(&section.ID, &section.TechID, &section.Status, &section.LessonReadAccess, &section.CreatedAt, &section.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &section, nil
}

func (r SectionRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, section domain.Section) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE section SET tech_id=$1, status=$2, lesson_read_access=$3, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$4`, section.TechID, section.Status, section.LessonReadAccess, section.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

func (r SectionRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE section SET status=$1, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$2`, domain.SectionStatusNoActive, id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

func (r SectionRepoPG) ListAll(ctx context.Context) ([]domain.Section, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `SELECT id, tech_id, status, lesson_read_access, created_at, updated_at FROM section ORDER BY created_at`)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := []domain.Section{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var section domain.Section
		if err := rows.Scan(&section.ID, &section.TechID, &section.Status, &section.LessonReadAccess, &section.CreatedAt, &section.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, section)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (r SectionRepoPG) ListByModule(ctx context.Context, moduleID string) ([]domain.Section, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, `
SELECT s.id, s.tech_id, s.status, s.lesson_read_access, s.created_at, s.updated_at
FROM module_section ms
JOIN section s ON s.id = ms.section_id
WHERE ms.module_id = $1
ORDER BY ms."order" ASC, s.id ASC`, moduleID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := []domain.Section{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var section domain.Section
		if err := rows.Scan(&section.ID, &section.TechID, &section.Status, &section.LessonReadAccess, &section.CreatedAt, &section.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, section)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

var _ repository.SectionRepository = (*SectionRepoPG)(nil)
